```yaml
name: Update Nix Vendor Hash

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "go.mod"
      - "go.sum"
      - "flake.nix"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-vendorhash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31

      - name: Validate helper script
        run: bash -n scripts/update-vendorhash.sh

      - name: Check if vendorHash needs updating
        id: check
        run: |
          # Check if flake.nix has a vendorHash
          if grep -q "vendorHash" flake.nix; then
            echo "has_vendorhash=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_vendorhash=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Compute new vendorHash
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_vendorhash == 'true'
        id: compute_new_hash
        run: |
          # Run the helper script to compute new vendorHash
          ./scripts/update-vendorhash.sh
          
          # Check if there are changes
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "no_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "no_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push changes
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_vendorhash == 'true' && steps.compute_new_hash.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add flake.nix
          git commit -m "Update vendorHash" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.head_ref }} || echo "Push failed, likely due to branch protection"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_vendorhash == 'true' && steps.compute_new_hash.outputs.no_changes == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "Update vendorHash"
          title: "Update Nix vendorHash"
          body: "Automated update of the Nix vendorHash based on changes to go.mod/go.sum"
          branch: update-nix-vendorhash-${{ github.run_id }}
          delete-branch: true
```
